steps.analyst_reply: {"root_cause": "The scorecard relies on a single holistic judgment, and two recurring text patterns fool it. First, physician-assistant bios (PA degrees, PA programs, 'PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT' experience) are pulled toward nurse even though the labels consistently treat PAs as physicians; second, formulaic NPI-registry listings that state no specialty, degree, or credentials are read as physician but are consistently nurses.
